title: How many BIM models a project may have
question: Is a project limited to one BIM model, or may it hold several (per project, per location), with users switching between them in design and compare views?
context: The hierarchy-management PRD asks for several BIM models and sheets per level. The web assumes BIM is uploaded once per project and shows a non-blocking warning otherwise; child locations inherit the parent's BIM (DSGN-REQ-005, DSGN-REQ-029).
